outcome: Incidence of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASI)
cohort: 1,933,930 primiparous women and women with VBAC who had vaginal deliveries between 2004 and 2016 in Austria, Canada, Norway, and Sweden.
finding: The incidence of OASI varied considerably between countries and over time, with Canada and Sweden having the highest rates and Austria and Norway the lowest.
mod_finding: The incidence of OASI varied by mode of delivery, with forceps deliveries having the highest rates.
